name: ChatGPT
description: General-purpose assistant for writing, analysis, coding, brainstorming, and task planning.
installSteps: Open ChatGPT.
Create or sign in to your account.
Describe the task and constraints.
Review and adapt the output before using it.

name: Grammarly
description: Writing assistant for grammar, tone, clarity, and email/document polishing.
installSteps: Open Grammarly.
Install the browser extension or desktop app.
Enable it for your writing surfaces.
Use suggestions to revise text.

name: Notion AI
description: Workspace AI for summarizing notes, drafting docs, and organizing project knowledge.
installSteps: Open Notion.
Enable Notion AI in your workspace.
Create or open a page.
Ask AI to draft, summarize, or transform workspace content.

name: Perplexity
description: Answer engine for cited research, source discovery, and quick topic exploration.
installSteps: Open Perplexity.
Sign in if you want history saved.
Ask a focused research question.
Open cited sources to verify important claims.

name: GitHub Copilot
description: AI coding assistant for autocomplete, chat, tests, and code explanation inside developer tools.
installSteps: Open GitHub Copilot.
Start or confirm a subscription.
Install the IDE extension.
Sign in to GitHub from your IDE.
Use inline suggestions or chat for your coding task.

name: Canva Magic Studio
description: Design assistant for presentations, social posts, images, and brand-ready creative assets.
installSteps: Open Canva Magic Studio.
Choose a template or create a design.
Describe the design outcome.
Export or share the finished asset.

name: Zapier AI
description: Automation assistant for connecting apps and building AI-assisted workflows.
installSteps: Open Zapier AI.
Connect the apps involved in your workflow.
Describe the automation trigger and action.
Test the Zap before turning it on.

name: Fireflies.ai
description: Meeting assistant for recording, transcribing, summarizing, and searching meetings.
installSteps: Open Fireflies.ai.
Connect your calendar or meeting platform.
Invite the bot to meetings.
Review summaries and action items after calls.
